Distinguish between precise and accurate measurements.

Accurate measurement means capable of providing a correct reading or measurement. In physical science, it means correct. A measurement is accurate if it correctly reflects the size of the thing being measured.

Precise measurement means exact, as in performance, execution, or amount. In physical science it means repeatable, reliable, getting the same measurement each time. 3• between accuracy and precession of measurement.
